checks.note: It names the `cart=[]` default as the cause, since that list is created once when the function is defined.
It says every call shares and mutates the same list, so the second call adds pen and book together (12 instead of 10).
The fix uses `cart=None` and sets `cart = []` inside when cart is None.
Only the default value changes and two lines are added. The rest of the function is unchanged.
The explanation is accurate and short. The expected outputs (2 and 10) are correct.
